text: ここは　シオン　タウン　シオンは　むらさき　とうとい　いろ
note: The sign calls purple the "noble colour" because in old Japan purple was reserved for the highest court ranks.
claim: In Japan's Twelve Level Cap and Rank System of 603, purple was the colour of the highest rank.
